SCRIBBOT.Settings.BotUrl.Name: ScribBot URL
SCRIBBOT.Settings.BotUrl.Hint: Address of the ScribBot API, as seen from the GM's browser. Stored per browser.
SCRIBBOT.Settings.Token.Name: ScribBot API token
SCRIBBOT.Settings.Token.Hint: The API_TOKEN from ScribBot's .env file. Stored per browser, so players never see it.
SCRIBBOT.Settings.Folder.Name: Journal folder
SCRIBBOT.Settings.Folder.Hint: Session summaries are created in this journal folder.
SCRIBBOT.Settings.AutoImport.Name: Import summaries automatically
SCRIBBOT.Settings.AutoImport.Hint: Create the journal entry as soon as ScribBot finishes a summary.
SCRIBBOT.Settings.Transcript.Name: Include full transcript
SCRIBBOT.Settings.Transcript.Hint: Add a page with the complete session transcript to each journal entry.
SCRIBBOT.Settings.PlayersView.Name: Players can read summaries
SCRIBBOT.Settings.PlayersView.Hint: Give all players Observer permission on imported session journals.
SCRIBBOT.Settings.DiscordIds.Name: Discord IDs
SCRIBBOT.Settings.DiscordIds.Label: Link Discord accounts
SCRIBBOT.Settings.DiscordIds.Hint: Link each Foundry user to their Discord account so ScribBot knows who is speaking.
